_note: Stapling strategy catalogue supplied by the team. Qualitative assessments are the team's own; no per-locus claims are made here.

strategies.name: CLOuD9-style inducible dCas dimerization
strategies.how: Two orthogonal dCas proteins carry complementary dimerization domains; a small molecule makes them bind.

strategies.name: LADL optogenetic looping
strategies.how: dCas9 anchors loci; a CRY2/CIBN interaction induced with blue light brings them together.

strategies.name: Direct bivalent dCas / leucine zippers
strategies.how: Two DNA-bound dCas proteins are constitutively physically linked.

strategies.name: BPCL bioorthogonal "click" bridge
strategies.how: CRISPR-targeted adaptors undergo selective chemical coupling between loci.

strategies.name: Recruit a natural looping factor such as LDB1
strategies.how: A DNA binder recruits a protein already capable of engaging a distal enhancer complex.

strategies.name: CTCF/cohesin engineering
strategies.how: Recruit architectural proteins or manipulate loop-extrusion anchors to reshape topology.

strategies.name: ZF/TALE-based tethering
strategies.how: Custom protein DNA binders replace CRISPR targeting.
strategies.issue: New protein engineering for every locus
